rule: An official past-paper question always beats a PMT question; between two PMT questions the earlier (Core Pure 1 before Core Pure 2, then chapter, then question) is kept. No chains existed: none of the four PMT originals was itself a copy.
derivation: Re-derived from duplicateOf in pmt-catalogue.json (v0.76) and the duplicates lists of docs/evidence/v075-import-pmt-core-pure-1.json and v076-import-pmt-core-pure-2.json: 51 copies (Core Pure 1 15, Core Pure 2 36; 47 of official past-paper questions, 4 of PMT questions), identical to the brief. No difference.
carryOver: Before deletion each survivor gained the chapter keys and skill mappings the copy had and it lacked (13 survivors; exam rows in exam-catalogue.json and pilot-metadata.json). Wording, marks, mark schemes and difficulty of every survivor are unchanged (checked field by field against v0.76).
migration: pmt-catalogue.json "migrations" maps each removed ID to its retained ID. The Papers page rewrites a restored selection once (position kept, a question selected twice kept once) and saves the new IDs.
